package.name: robotops_trace_cpp
package.description: RobotOps distributed-tracing SDK core for C++ (the "SDK + carrier" pivot). Provides the RAII span guard, the ROBOTOPS_TRACE() macro, thread-local trace context, async capture/restore, an OTLP exporter, and RobotOps::init(). Transport-agnostic and buildable WITHOUT ROS (plain-CMake fallback) so the core survives beyond any single middleware.
